chemistry_notes.text: Type II photosensitization: 4,7-diphenyl-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole absorbs at 420 nm, undergoes ISC to T1, sensitizes 3O2 to 1O2, which selectively oxidizes Fmoc-L-methionine thioether to sulfoxide. Key design decisions: (1) PFA tubing used (inventory constraint; PFA is transparent to visible light, compatible with MeCN, rated to 60°C and 10 bar). (2) 1 mm ID coil gives short optical path length for uniform photon delivery, addressing batch Beer-Lambert limitation. realized_proposal.mixing_order_reasoning: Chemistry Plan: Stream A (liquid, HPLC pump) and Stream B (air, MFC) meet at PFA T-mixer (mixer_photo_t) upstream of the 1 mL PFA photocoil. Gas-liquid segmented (Taylor) flow forms in 1 mm ID PFA tubing, maximizing O2 interfacial area. T-mixer is the only available mixer in inventory.
pre_reactor_steps: Prepare Stream A containing Fmoc-L-methionine (1.0 equiv, 0.10 M in acetonitrile), 4,7-diphenyl-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole (10 mol%, 0.010 M in acetonitrile), Acetonitrile in acetonitrile at 0.1 M; concentration basis: reference component: Fmoc-L-methionine.
Install reactor reactor_photo_100 (1 mL, 1 mm ID, PFA).
Install assigned feeds A:pump_photo_liquid, B:mfc_air_10.
Set the outlet BPR to 3 bar gauge and start liquid feeds at final outlet flow 0.2 mL/min.
Set gas Stream B (air) to 2.13455 sccm at inlet/STP (0.580355 mL/min in-channel; 1 equiv O2 relative to limiting substrate).
post_reactor_steps: Effluent passes through 3.0 bar BPR (bpr_photo_3) then into vented gas-liquid separator (separator_photo_gl) to vent excess air safely.
Liquid product collected in amber vented collection vessel (collector_photo_100) under ambient conditions; amber vessel minimizes product photodegradation.
No inline quench required — reaction is self-terminating upon removal from light and O2 (Chemistry Plan: quench_required = false).
Collect only after the canonical residence-time stabilization period; use the inventory-compiled downstream path.
For shutdown, stop reactive cofeeds and reagent gas first, flush with a compatible declared solvent, then depressurize through the controlled outlet.

reasoning_per_field.finalization_authority: All numerical run parameters were regenerated by the deterministic post-council realizer; earlier model-written numbers are non-authoritative.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL:
Exact inventory reactor reactor_photo_100 supplies V_R=1 mL.
Scientific rationale: Inventory: only available reactor is reactor_photo_100 at 1.0 mL. Calculation suggested 4.86 mL but that reactor does not exist in inventory. Using 1.0 mL inventory reactor; flow rate adjusted to 0.25 mL/min liquid to achieve ~4 min inlet residence time. Consistency check: V = t_inlet × (Q_liq + Q_gas_STP) = 4 × (0.25 + 0.083) = 1.33 mL — slight overestimate; actual t_inlet = 1.0/0.333 = 3.0 min. Rounding to 4 min as conservative screening target; recommend confirming at 0.2 mL/min for exact 4 min.
reasoning_per_field.flow_rate_mL_min: Sum of non-quench liquid feeds is 0.2 mL/min after per-pump bounds and stoichiometric ratios were solved jointly.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Derived from the selected reactor volume and the declared basis: 0.428349 min (inlet/STP apparent residence time).
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar:
Selected from declared pressure hardware only: 3 bar gauge; absolute pressure for gas calculations is 4.01325 bar.
Scientific rationale: Calculation: BPR required for gas-liquid system (mandatory). Only available BPR is 3.0 bar (bpr_photo_3). Chemistry Plan specifies 3 bar. Acetonitrile bp = 82°C >> 21°C operating, so solvent boiling not the driver — gas-liquid stability is. 3.0 bar selected.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C:
Final temperature 21 deg C is within the assigned reactor/controller limits. Hardware feasibility does not establish reaction rate or yield; validate the chemical operating point experimentally.
Scientific rationale: Protocol fact: 21°C. Inventory allows 21°C (allowed_temperatures_C). No thermal advantage needed — reaction proceeds at RT. Analogy 1: 25°C, Analogy 2: 50°C, Analogy 3: 25°C — all higher, but our batch already achieves 99% at 21°C so no temperature increase justified.
reasoning_per_field.superficial_velocity: Stage 1: liquid 4.24413 mm/s; gas 12.3155 mm/s. Calculated as u = Q/(pi*ID^2/4), using mL/min*1000/60 for mm3/s and inlet gas volume at reactor temperature and pressure. These use the empty cross-section, without porosity or slip correction; they do not establish bed wetting, flow regime or mass transfer.
reasoning_per_field.gas_time_interpretation: V/Q_liquid is nominal liquid space time (empty-bed space time for a packed bed). V/(Q_liquid+Q_gas_STP) is a mixed-reference volume index, not a physical contact time. V/(Q_liquid+Q_gas_at_reactor_conditions) is a geometric inlet turnover estimate; phase holdup, slip, gas consumption and actual contact time remain unmeasured. The selected primary basis is stated in residence_time_basis.
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: Scientific rationale: Protocol fact: 0.10 M. Analogy 3 also uses 0.10 M — directly consistent. No adjustment needed.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_ID_mm: Scientific rationale: Inventory: reactor_photo_100 has 1.0 mm ID. Calculation used 1.0 mm ID. Analogy 1 used 2 mm ID quartz — larger, less uniform irradiation. 1 mm ID gives shorter optical path (Beer-Lambert advantage) and higher Pe. Direct inventory assignment.

residence_time_min.text: Batch time = 5 min at 99% yield. Calculation estimated τ = 0.8 min (6× IF) but flagged O2 transfer sufficiency at only 0.19× demand and Da=92 (mass-transfer limited). Analogies 1–3 are single-phase photoredox with 12–30 min residence times — not directly applicable to this fast gas-liquid reaction. Setting τ_inlet = 4 min as conservative screening start: longer than calculation minimum (0.8 min) to compensate for O2 transfer limitation, shorter than batch (5 min) to exploit flow intensification, within 0.6–1.2 min calculation range only if O2 transfer is not limiting. Recommend screening 2–8 min. Basis: inlet/STP as required for gas-liquid design.
residence_time_min.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

residence_time_basis.text: Gas-liquid reagent feed present (air MFC). O2 equivalents determined by inlet/STP MFC flow only. residence_time_inlet_min = V_reactor / (Q_liq + Q_gas_STP) = 1.0 / (0.25 + 0.0833) = ~3.0 min; rounded to 4 min to account for conservative O2 transfer. In-channel time is pressure-corrected diagnostic: at 3 bar, gas compressed ~3×, so t_channel ≈ t_inlet × Q_gas_STP/(Q_gas_STP + Q_liq×3) correction gives ~2.4 min — reported as diagnostic only.

residence_time_inlet_min.text: Same as residence_time_min = 4.0 min; primary design basis for gas-liquid system per universal physics rules.

Reported as ~2.4 min using intermediate estimate. Never used as primary basis.

chemistry_notes.text: Type II photosensitization: 4,7-diphenyl-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole absorbs at 420 nm, undergoes ISC to T1, sensitizes 3O2 to 1O2, which selectively oxidizes Fmoc-L-methionine thioether to sulfoxide. Key design decisions: (1) PFA tubing used (inventory constraint; PFA is transparent to visible light, compatible with MeCN, rated to 60°C and 10 bar). (2) 1 mm ID coil gives short optical path length for uniform photon delivery, addressing batch Beer-Lambert limitation. (3) Gas-liquid segmented flow with air MFC addresses O2 mass-transfer limitation (batch: headspace diffusion only). (4) BPR at 3.0 bar mandatory for gas-liquid system to maintain stable slug flow and prevent uncontrolled degassing. (5) Residence time set to ~4 min (inlet/STP basis) — longer than batch 5 min but justified by O2 transfer sufficiency warning (Da=92, O2 transfer 0.19× demand); screening at 2–8 min range recommended. (6) Analogies 1–3 are all single-phase photoredox (Ir/Ru, no gas co-feed) — not directly applicable for gas-liquid parameters; hardware parameters (FEP/PFA tubing, ~1–5 mL reactor, blue LED, 25–50°C) confirm general photochemistry flow setup. Residence time from analogies (12–30 min) is longer than our 5 min batch, so batch time is the primary anchor. (7) Over-oxidation to sulfone is a risk at long residence times — 4 min is conservative. (8) Incompatible pair: Fmoc + base — no base present, not a concern here.
chemistry_notes.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety
